title: Settings for my appearance
excerpt: Settings Options Editor Display Deactivate Readable Line Length Settings Options Editor Behavior Spellcheck languages + Choose German or German (Germany) Settings Options Files and
markdown:
- Settings > *Options* > Editor > *Display* > **Deactivate** Readable Line Length
- Settings > *Options* > Editor > *Behavior* > Spellcheck languages > + > **Choose** German or German (Germany)
- Settings > *Options* > Files and links > Deleted Files > **Choose** Move to Obsidian trash
- Settings > *Options* > Files and links > **Activate** Automatically update internal links 
- Settings > *Options* > Files and links > **Activate** Detect all file extensions 
- Settings > *Options* > Appearance > Themes > Manage > **Install and enable** "ITS Theme"
- Settings > *Options* > Appearance > *Font* > **Activate** Quick Font Size Adjustments 
- Settings > *Options* > Core Plugins > **Activate** Workspaces
- Settings > *Core Plugins* > Backlinks > **Activate** Show backlinks at the bottom of notes
- Settings > *Core Plugins* > Templates > Template folder location > **Enter** Shared/z_templates 
- Settings > *Community Plugins* > Folder Notes > *General* > *Folder note behavior* > Deleted Folder Notes > **Choose** Move to Obsidian trash
- Settings > *Community Plugins* > Folder Notes > *File Explorer* > **Deactivate** Disable Folder Collapsing
- Settings > *Community Plugins* > Leaflet > Default Map Marker > ... (explanations follow later)
- Settings > *Community Plugins* > Leaflet > Additional Map Markers > ... (explanations follow later)
- Settings > *Community Plugins* > Supercharged Links > Target Attributes for styling > **Enter** "Verfahren, Projekttyp, Privilegierung"
- Settings > *Community Plugins* > Supercharged Links > *Styling* > New Selector > **Click** New > Type of selector > **Choose** Tag > Tag > **Enter** "Projekt" > **Click** Save
- Settings > *Community Plugins* > Supercharged Links > *Styling* > New Selector > **Click** New > Type of selector > **Choose** Attribute value > Attribute name > **Choose** Verfahren > Attribute value > **Enter** "Agri" > *Advanced* > Matching type > **Choose** Contains value > **Click** Save
- Settings > *Community Plugins* > Supercharged Links > *Styling* > New Selector > **Click** New > Type of selector > **Choose** Attribute value > Attribute name > **Choose** Verfahren > Attribute value > **Enter** "Batterie" > *Advanced* > Matching type > **Choose** Contains value > **Click** Save
- Settings > *Community Plugins* > Supercharged Links > *Styling* > New Selector > **Click** New > Type of selector > **Choose** Attribute value > Attribute name > **Choose** Verfahren > Attribute value > **Enter** "Dach" > *Advanced* > Matching type > **Choose** Contains value > **Click** Save
- Settings > *Community Plugins* > Supercharged Links > *Styling* > New Selector > **Click** New > Type of selector > **Choose** Attribute value > Attribute name > **Choose** Verfahren > Attribute value > **Enter** "Immo" > *Advanced* > Matching type > **Choose** Contains value > **Click** Save
- Settings > *Community Plugins* > Style Settings > ITS Theme Settings > Alternate Color Schemes > **Activate** Accent Color
- Settings > *Community Plugins* > Style Settings > Supercharged Links > **Click** on each category (e.g. Agri, Batterie, Dach, Immo) > Link color > **Choose** color of each category (e.g. #6472C6 for Projekt, #009B41 for Agri, #DC1A5A for Batterie, #5DD6D1 for Dach, and #471F04 for Immo) and for each **Click** save
- Settings > *Community Plugins* > Relay > *Join a Relay Server* > Share key > **Enter** pass key and click enter (unless you already joined)
- Settings > *Community Plugins* > Relay > *Relay Servers* > **Choose** Relay Server (e.g. iAccess) > *Folders on this Relay Server* > **Click** Add to Vault for "Shared"  (unless you already added it)
- Settings > *Community Plugins* > Relay > *Relay Servers* > **Choose** Relay Server (e.g. iAccess) > *Folders on this Relay Server* > **Click** "Shared" > *Sync Settings* > **Activate** all
- **Copy** CSS Snippets folder "snippets" into the .obsidian folder (see CSS Snippets for more explanations)
- Settings > *Options* > Appearance > *CSS Snippets* > **Activate** all
- Zwei Notes öffnen > sie werden als zwei getrennte Tabs geöffnet. > Einen Tab nach rechts ziehen um zwei nebeneinander abzulegen. > Nun wird der aktive Tab (z.B. der rechte) immer ausgetauscht, wenn im Explorer links etwas neues angeklickt wird. Und eine History baut sich auf. Der linke Tab kann jetzt z.B. angepinnt werden. Dann wird er nie ausgetauscht, auch wenn man in ihm etwas anklickt.
- Open command palette > **Type** Relay > **Choose** "Relay: Enable debugging"
- Open command palette > **Type** Relay > **Choose** "Relay: Show feature flags" > **Activate** enableCanvasSync and check that enableAttachmentSync is activated
- Close Obsidian and open it again (you should now see a message about the new .base files)
